title: Send Entra Policy Suite's identity report to Log Analytics and read the exposure lists
purpose: Makes (or completes) the custom table EntraUsersMetadata_CL with v1's columns, a data collection endpoint and the data collection rule dcr-entra-EntraUsersMetadata_CL in your workspace, gives the engine's managed identity exactly two rights (Monitoring Metrics Publisher on that rule, Log Analytics Reader on that workspace), reads every step back and stores the target in the Entra Policy Suite database. It does not switch the upload on.
whenToRun: Once, before switching on 'Send the report to Log Analytics' (Settings > Identity report); again after adding a user tag type, so the table gets its column.

runAs.name: Contributor + User Access Administrator (or Owner)
runAs.scope: the workspace's resource group (and the data collection resource group, if another)
runAs.why: creates the table, the endpoint and the rule, and the engine's two role assignments

runAs.name: Contributor (or any role that may start a Container Apps job)
runAs.why: starts the database setup job, which stores the target (audited) - no database right needed

changes.object: the table EntraUsersMetadata_CL (or its missing columns; existing columns and their types are kept)
changes.why: the identity report's users are stored there, as v1 did

changes.object: the data collection endpoint (default dce-entrapolicysuite) and the rule dcr-entra-EntraUsersMetadata_CL
changes.why: the Logs Ingestion API sends through them
changes.undo: delete the rule and the endpoint

changes.scope: the one data collection rule ONLY

changes.why: it reads the exposure lists (the table + the sign-in logs)
the engine reads where to send
changes.undo: switch 'Send the report to Log Analytics' off

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: WorkspaceResourceId
parameters.help: the Log Analytics workspace (its resource id) - the one that holds the Entra sign-in logs, so the exposure lists can be built

parameters.name: DataCollectionResourceGroup
parameters.help: where the endpoint and the rule are made

parameters.name: DceName
parameters.help: the data collection endpoint to make or to use (v1's EPSAzDceNameSrv, to reuse v1's)

parameters.name: TagColumn
parameters.help: user tag type columns beyond v1's four, as the Identity page names them (e.g. Company, Tag_Department)

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (found by itself when it is the default)

readsOnly: Azure: the workspace, the table, the endpoint, the rule, the engine identity's role assignments on the rule and the workspace
whatIf: Every step it would take; nothing is changed.
undo: Switch 'Send the report to Log Analytics' off; remove the two role assignments, the rule, the endpoint and (if wanted) the table.
